Name: NPC Diary
Author: slpOff
Description:
[center][b][size=6]NPC Diary[/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][b]Turn your everyday moments with the villagers into a personal diary.
[/b][/b][/center]
NPC Diary gives each NPC a book where you can revisit conversations, remember gifts, write notes, and edit schedules—all from the Social menu.
[heading]Your Time Together, on One Calendar[/heading]
Open an NPC’s diary to browse a calendar of your interactions. Each date can display:
[list]
[*]Items you gave as gifts.[/*]
[*]Whether you talked to the NPC.[/*]
[*]Notes you wrote for that day.[/*]
[*]The NPC’s birthday.[/*]
[*]Your wedding date and yearly anniversaries with your spouse.[/*]
[/list]Use the seasonal bookmarks to browse the year, then select a date to open its daily entry.
[heading]Conversations Worth Keeping[/heading]
Revisit conversations you have experienced, with the time and location recorded alongside them.
You can preview recorded dialogue in the game’s dialogue window and edit it directly from the diary. When the original dialogue source is available, your changes can also be used in-game. Other entries can be edited as diary records.
[b]The diary records conversations you encounter while the mod is active. It does not reveal an NPC’s entire dialogue collection.[/b]
[heading]A Place for Your Notes[/heading]
Write reminders, plans, or memories directly on the diary page.
Notes save automatically when you switch pages or close the menu. Text editors support long entries, and you can click within the text to move the cursor.
[heading]Make Room in Their Schedule[/heading]
The diary also includes tools for editing NPC schedules:
[list]
[*]Adjust times, locations, facing directions, and actions.[/*]
[*]Choose locations and actions from autocomplete suggestions.[/*]
[*]Select destination tiles through the map selector.[/*]
[*]Write custom schedule dialogue without manually creating translation keys.[/*]
[/list]Removing all custom entries for a date restores the NPC’s default schedule.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*]SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b] EmotionFramework enables NPC emotion information in diary entries.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract NPCDiary.zip.[/*]
[*]Place the extracted NPCDiary folder inside your game’s Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]How to Open the Diary[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Open the [b]Social[/b] tab.[/*]
[*]Select an NPC to open their profile.[/*]
[*]Click the [b]closed-book icon beside their character[/b].[/*]
[*]Choose a date, then use the [b]Conversation[/b], [b]Gift[/b], and [b]Note[/b] bookmarks to browse that day.[/*]
[/list]The calendar page also lets you change the displayed year.
[heading]Updating and Keeping Your Records[/heading]
Diary records and custom edits are stored inside the NPCDiary mod folder. Back up that folder before updating, and preserve your existing data when replacing the mod files.
Schedule and dialogue overrides can apply across saves that use the same mod installation.
[heading]Languages[/heading]
[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]Korean[/*]
[/list]
